versions.content: The function shall behave as EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode in [7] , SWS_Eth Trcv_00042 . Instead of EthTrcv_XXX, the corresponding WEthTrcv_XXX functions shall be used. Instead of ETHTRCV _E_ YYY the corresponding development error WETHTRCV_E_YYY shall be used. Instead of EthTrcvSetTransceiverModeApi, WEthTrcvSetTransceiverModeApi shall be used. SWS_EthTrcv_00117 and SWS_EthTrcv_00118 do not apply.

The function shall behave as EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode in [7] , SWS_Eth Trcv_00042 . Instead of EthTrcv_XXX, the corresponding WEthTrcv_XXX functions shall be used. Instead of E THTRCV_E_ YYY the corresponding development error WETHTRCV_E_YYY shall be used. Instead of EthTrcvSetTransceiverModeApi, WEthTrcvSetTransceiverModeApi shall be used. SWS_EthTrcv_00117 and SWS_EthTrcv_00118 do not apply.
The function s hall put the index transceiver in the specified mode and indicate the new mode by the API EthIf_TrcvModeIndication latest during the next WEthTrcv_MainFunction.
